actualOriginal.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
actualOriginal.cn: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉受邀参加一个儿童聚会。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: I decided to take her by train.
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
actualOriginal.cn: 萨莉很兴奋，因为她以前从没坐过火车。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
actualOriginal.cn: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都问个不停。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
actualOriginal.cn: 突然，一位中年女士上了火车，坐在萨莉对面。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: 'Hello, little girl,' she said.
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
actualOriginal.cn: 萨莉没有回答，只是好奇地看着她。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
actualOriginal.cn: 那位女士穿着蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
actualOriginal.cn: 火车离开车站后，那位女士打开手提包，拿出了粉盒。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: She then began to make up her face.
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: 'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
actualOriginal.cn: ‘为了让自己漂亮。’那位女士回答。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
actualOriginal.cn: 她收好粉盒，和蔼地微笑着。
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

actualOriginal.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
actualOriginal.cn: 萨莉觉得很有趣，可我非常尴尬！
actualOriginal.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

existing.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
existing.cn: 那位妇女穿着一件蓝色的大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。
existing.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

existing.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact. She then began to make up her face.
existing.cn: 火车开出车站后，那位妇女打开了手提包，拿出了粉盒，然后开始打扮起来。
existing.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

existing.en: “Why are you doing that?” Sally asked.
existing.cn: “你为什么要那样做呢？”萨莉问。
existing.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

existing.en: “To make myself beautiful,” the lady answered. She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
existing.cn: “为了把自己打扮漂亮啊，”那位妇女答道。她放好了粉盒，慈祥地微笑着。
existing.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf

existing.en: “But you are still ugly,” Sally said. Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
existing.cn: “可你仍然很难看呀。”萨莉说。萨莉感到很有趣，而我却非常尴尬！
existing.sourceFile: 电子资料/新概念英语第一册学生用书.pdf
